# Social Media Video & Audio Downloader Telegram Bot

> High-performance Telegram bot that extracts and downloads ultra-high-definition videos (480p up to 8K UHD) and crystal-clear MP3 audio (320 kbps) from 1000+ social media platforms with intelligent pre-download size guard and chunked delivery.

## Project Overview
- **Name:** Telegram Media Downloader Bot
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Mazonia/media-downloader-bot
- **License:** MIT
- **Runtime:** Python 3.10+
- **Core Dependencies:** `python-telegram-bot` v21+, `yt-dlp`, `ffmpeg`

## Supported Platforms
- **YouTube:** Standard videos, live stream VODs, and Shorts in 480p, 720p, 1080p, 2K, 4K, and 8K.
- **TikTok:** High-definition video downloads with automatic watermark removal.
- **Instagram:** Reels, video posts, stories, and multi-slide carousel albums.
- **Twitter / X:** Native MP4 extraction with audio sync.
- **Reddit:** Merges separate Reddit video and DASH audio streams cleanly via FFmpeg.
- **Other Sites:** Facebook, Pinterest, Vimeo, Twitch clips, Soundcloud, and 1000+ sources supported by yt-dlp.

## Key Capabilities
- **Pre-Download 100MB Size Guard:** Estimates media size before downloading to disk. If exceeding 100MB, prompts user to save locally to PC disk (zero mobile data) or chunk and send to Telegram.
- **Dynamic Quality Ladder:** Probes source stream metadata and generates interactive inline buttons for only the qualities actually available.
- **Audio Extraction Engine:** Converts video streams directly into high-bitrate MP3 (320 kbps) with embedded cover art and metadata tags.
- **Automatic Chunk Splitter:** Seamlessly bypasses Telegram's 50MB bot upload cap by splitting large videos into 48MB parts.

## Quickstart & Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/Mazonia/media-downloader-bot.git
cd media-downloader-bot

# Set up virtual environment
python -m venv venv
.\venv\Scripts\activate

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Ensure FFmpeg is installed and on system PATH
ffmpeg -version

# Configure environment variables
copy .env.example .env
# Edit .env with BOT_TOKEN and ALLOWED_USER_IDS

# Start the bot
python bot.py
```
